item.title: InsightFinder raises $15M to help companies figure out where AI agents go wrong
item.description: According to CEO Helen Gu, the biggest problem facing the industry today is not just monitoring and diagnosing where AI models go wrong, it's diagnosing how the entire tech stack operates now that AI is a part of it.

item.title: AI traffic to US retailers rose 393% in Q1, and it’s boosting their revenue too
item.description: Adobe says AI traffic to U.S. retail sites also jumped 269% in March, with visitors converting better and generating more revenue than non-AI shoppers.

item.title: Roblox’s AI assistant gets new agentic tools to plan, build, and test games
item.description: The new new tools are designed to help creators throughout the entire development process.

item.title: Google is now targeting bad ads over bad actors
item.description: Google blocked 8.3 billion ads in 2025 but suspended fewer advertisers.

item.title: Runway CEO says AI could help Hollywood make 50 films instead of one $100M blockbuster
item.description: Runway’s CEO says AI could help studios make dozens of films for the cost of one, betting volume will boost hit-making odds.

item.title: Meta raises Quest 3 and Quest 3S prices due to RAM shortage
item.description: Starting April 19, the price of the Meta Quest 3S (128GB) and Meta Quest 3S (256GB) will go up by $50 to $349.99 and $449.99, respectively. The price of the Meta Quest 3 is going up by $100 to $599.99.

item.title: Canva’s AI assistant can now call various tools to make designs for you
item.description: The latest version of Canva's AI assistant lets users create editable designs with text prompts.

item.title: This simulation startup wants to be the Cursor for physical AI
item.description: Antioch raised a $8.5 million seed round to create simulation tools for a new generation of robot builders.

item.title: DeepL, known for text translation, now wants to translate your voice
item.description: DeepL says its tech could be used for real-time translation with meeting tools like Zoom and Microsoft Teams

item.title: OpenAI updates its Agents SDK to help enterprises build safer, more capable agents
item.description: OpenAI has expanded the capabilities of its agent-building toolkit, as agentic AI continues to grow in popularity.

item.title: Hightouch reaches $100M ARR fueled by marketing tools powered by AI
item.description: The startup says it grew its ARR by $70 million in just 20 months after launching an AI agent platform for marketers.

item.title: LinkedIn data shows AI isn’t to blame for hiring decline… yet
item.description: LinkedIn says hiring is down 20% since 2022, but blames higher interest rates — not AI — for the slowdown.

item.title: AI learning app Gizmo levels up with 13M users and a $22M investment
item.description: Gizmo, an AI-powered learning platform, has attracted more than 13 million users and just secured $22 million in Series A funding.

item.title: Can AI judge journalism? A Thiel-backed startup says yes, even if it risks chilling whistleblowers
item.description: Objection, a Thiel-backed startup, aims to use AI to judge journalism, letting users pay to challenge stories. Critics warn it could chill whistleblowers and reshape how media accountability works.

item.title: Google rolls out a native Gemini app for Mac
item.description: You can share anything on their screen with Gemini to get help with what they're looking at in the moment, including local files.

item.title: The musician-turned-biotech-founder waiting to fundraise
item.description: When Grammy-nominated singer-songwriter Aloe Blacc got COVID despite being vaccinated and boosted, he tried to fund research for a better solution. What he quickly found out? You can’t just write a check in biotech. Regulators require a commercialization plan, and philanthropy doesn’t move science through clinical trials or get you a license on university IP. item.title: India’s vibe-coding startup Emergent enters OpenClaw-like AI agent space
item.description: Emergent's Wingman lets users manage and automate tasks through chat on platforms like WhatsApp and Telegram.

item.title: After sale of its shoe business, Allbirds pivots to AI
item.description: Allbirds is ditching wool sneakers for AI servers, rebranding as NewBird AI after locking in a $50M convertible financing facility.

item.title: Reid Hoffman weighs in on the ‘tokenmaxxing’ debate
item.description: Reid Hoffman says tracking AI token use can gauge adoption, but cautions it should be paired with context and not treated as a direct productivity metric.
